def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return np.where(bins >= item, np.floor(bins / item) / ((bins % item) + 1), -np.inf)

algorithm: {For each bin, if the item fits, calculate the priority score as the product of the remaining capacity after placing one item and the maximum number of additional identical items that can fit into the bin’s remaining space, otherwise assign negative infinity, with higher scores representing more preferred bins.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_cap = bins - item
    extra_items = np.floor(remaining_cap / item)
    scores = remaining_cap * extra_items
    return np.where(fit_mask, scores, -np.inf)

algorithm: {For each bin, calculate the remaining capacity after placing the given item, assign a priority equal to the negative of the remaining capacity if the bin can fit the item, otherwise assign negative infinity to mark the bin as unsuitable.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    return np.where(remaining >= 0, -remaining, -np.inf)
